77ec6a.conditions: A process finishes its L-solve and starts the U-solve, sending an RD_U lsum message (on the same grid->comm) to a process that is still in its L-solve receive loop waiting for an RD_L from a third rank. No barrier separates the two phases with Pz=1.
77ec6a.reasoning: dForwardSolve3d_newsolve_reusepdgstrs receives exactly nfrecvx+nfrecvmod messages with MPI_Recv(ANY_SOURCE, ANY_TAG, grid->comm) and handles only tags BC_L/RD_L. Unlike the 2D pdgstrs, it has no MPI_Barrier after the L-solve (it is commented out at line 4180), and with -d 1 the z-reduction and broadcast do nothing. The U-solve (line 5946) uses the same communicator with tags BC_U/RD_U. On a 1x3 grid with a forest etree, one rank can finish its forward solve and send RD_U to a rank that still expects RD_L from another rank. The wildcard receive can take the RD_U. It matches neither branch, is dropped, and still counts as a received message, so an fmod counter never reaches zero. That y block is never solved or forwarded, and the ranks waiting on it block forever (or the stray RD_L is lost in the U-solve). Whether this happens depends on arrival order.
